2026_05_TB_DAL.headline: Prescott’s Precision Meets Daniels’ Rookie Nerves in Thursday Night Showdown
2026_05_TB_DAL.paragraph1: Dallas is banking on Dak Prescott’s laser‑accurate timing with his top target CeeDee Lamb, whose 37 receptions have already led the league. Meanwhile, Tampa Bay’s rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels, fresh off a shaky debut, will rely on the newly hired offensive coordinator Zac Robinson to simplify the play‑call and get the Bucs’ line moving for Bucky Irving’s inside runs. The clash pits a veteran’s rhythm against a freshman’s poise, with each side’s game plan hinging on protecting the ball and exploiting mismatches.
2026_05_TB_DAL.model_rationale: Prescott’s chemistry with Lamb should stretch the Bucs’ secondary, while Daniels’ inexperience may struggle against Dallas’s aggressive pass rush.
